title: Cancel delayed response-board source navigation after newer user scroll
outcome: AgentSessionPanel's response-board source-navigation subscription requests a bounded around-position history page and retries jumpToMessageId in requestAnimationFrame without checking the shared virtualizer user-scroll generation. If the user wheels, pages, or drags the scrollbar between acceptance and the frame, the delayed retry can yank the viewport. Align this path with useConversationMarkerJump: begin/capture the shared generation, then retry only if request/session/generation are still current; cover scroll cancellation and session-switch cancellation.
acceptance: Delayed Response Board source navigation is canceled by newer wheel, page/arrow keys, scrollbar or touch navigation both before history completion and before the queued jump frame, including when the transcript remains non-virtualized and both handles are null. Without newer navigation, short DOM transcripts still jump successfully. Existing virtualized cancellation, fresh-handle handoff, superseding request, rejection, session-switch and unmount guards remain intact. Add a null-handle cancellation regression that fails before the fix and verify affected suites and TypeScript.
